summary.zh: 把自然语言需求生成可运行的项目骨架
summary.en: Turn a written spec into a runnable repository scaffold

description.zh: 把自然语言写成的需求变成结构完整、可直接运行的项目仓库，支持 Next.js、FastAPI、Rails、Go、Rust、Flutter 等技术栈。适合从想法或规格文档起步搭建新项目时使用。
description.en: Turns a written spec or idea into a complete, runnable repository, covering stacks such as Next.js, FastAPI, Rails, Go, Rust and Flutter. Use it when a project starts from requirements rather than existing code.
